The '''Ggy-ynt system''' was located in the [[Esuain sector/Legends|Esuain sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang known as the [[Bandits of Ggy-ynt]].<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ggy-ynt [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-7.<ref name="TEA" />
